verdict.rationale: Working Copy offers real background automation via Auto-Sync/Background Sync (auto commit-pull-push) and Shortcuts app integration for chaining automations, which can run without user intervention. However, this is git-sync automation rather than AI-agent-driven scheduling, and the docs show no way to trigger the Repository Agent or custom scripts autonomously on a schedule/trigger without the app being open. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-agent-initiated autonomous tasks (not just sync), scheduled/triggered automation beyond Shortcuts, and independent confirmation of reliability of background execution.
